# vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp

## Overview

[`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L587-L614) is an implementation file for the `descriptor_indexing` category's misc common non-uniform sampled-image-array cases. Its public entry point, [`createDescriptorIndexingMiscTests`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L587-L614), receives the already-created category group and appends four direct root test cases named from the `arraysize` and target-coordinate dimensions.

The file focuses on one compute-shader pattern: three sampled-image descriptor arrays are indexed with the invocation ID and wrapped in `nonuniformEXT`, then sampled values are combined as `a * b + c` and written to an output storage buffer ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L131-L165)). The caller is the main descriptor-set registration function, which invokes this misc registration after adding `non_uniform_atomics` ([`vktDescriptorSetsIndexingTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorSetsIndexingTests.cpp#L4920-L4923)).

## Role

Implementation file for misc direct-root sampled-image-array tests. It does not create a nested `TestCaseGroup`; it adds `CommonNonUniformDescriptorIndexTestCase` children directly to the category group passed by the caller ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L587-L612)).

This page uses `descriptor_indexing` as the Level-3 root because the misc factory receives the category group and calls `mainGroup->addChild(...)` directly. The parseable tree below intentionally lists only the direct category-root children represented by this source file, rather than repeating the larger direct-child tree implemented by other descriptor-indexing files.

## Test Families

### misc_common_nonuniform_index_arraysize_8_at_0 — Eight sampled images per array at coordinate 0

This case is generated when the registration loop selects `arraySize = 8u` and the coordinate entry `{ Vec2(0.0f, 0.0f), "0" }` ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L596-L609)). It dispatches a compute shader with `local_size_x = 8`, so each invocation indexes one element of each of the three sampled-image descriptor arrays ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L131-L145), [`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L523-L525)).

### misc_common_nonuniform_index_arraysize_8_at_mid — Eight sampled images per array at midpoint coordinate

This case uses the same `arraySize = 8u` path with the coordinate entry `{ Vec2(0.5f, 0.5f), "mid" }` ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L596-L609)). The shader source formats the coordinate into the `textureLod` calls and uses `nonuniformEXT` around each sampled image descriptor selection ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L133-L160)).

### misc_common_nonuniform_index_arraysize_64_at_0 — Sixty-four sampled images per array at coordinate 0

This case is generated by the same registration loop when `arraySize = 64u` and coordinate name `0` are selected ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L598-L611)). The support check scales descriptor consumption as `kNumArrays * m_params.numElementsPerArray`, so this variant requires 192 sampled-image descriptors within `maxPerStageDescriptorSampledImages` ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L73-L75), [`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L113-L118)).

### misc_common_nonuniform_index_arraysize_64_at_mid — Sixty-four sampled images per array at midpoint coordinate

This case combines `arraySize = 64u` with coordinate name `mid` from the two nested registration loops ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L596-L611)). It exercises the same three-array non-uniform sampled-image expression as the other variants but over 64 descriptor elements per array and a 64-wide compute local size ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L133-L165)).

## Support / Feature Requirements

The misc test case requires the `VK_EXT_descriptor_indexing` device functionality before checking descriptor-indexing feature bits ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L100-L108)). It then rejects devices without `runtimeDescriptorArray` or without `shaderSampledImageArrayNonUniformIndexing`, matching the runtime sampled-image-array usage in the generated compute shader ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L105-L112), [`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L146-L160)).

The descriptor-count gate is proportional to the parameterized array size: `numSampledImages` is `3 * numElementsPerArray` and must not exceed `maxPerStageDescriptorSampledImages` ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L113-L118)). The file also queries image-format support for `VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D`, optimal tiling, and transfer-destination plus sampled usage for the selected format, failing support if the format is reported unsupported for that use ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L120-L128)).

## Verification Methods

Each invocation samples the same descriptor index from all three arrays, computes `data[index] = a * b + c`, and writes one `uvec4` to the output SSBO ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L152-L162)). Before dispatch, the implementation creates `3 * numElementsPerArray` sampled images, initializes host-visible color buffers with deterministic grayscale-derived values plus the element index, and copies each buffer into its corresponding sampled image ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L313-L350), [`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L495-L512)).

After `cmdDispatch`, the output buffer is synchronized for host reads and invalidated ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L523-L539)). The CPU reference path reads the initialized color buffers at the same sampled coordinate, applies the same three-array arithmetic, and compares each `UVec4` output element with `deMemCmp`; the first mismatch returns `TestStatus::fail("Fail")`, and a full match returns `TestStatus::pass("Pass")` ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L541-L582)).

## Test Principles Observed

- The four cases isolate a common descriptor-indexing pattern rather than broad descriptor-type coverage: all variants use sampled-image arrays and one shared sampler ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L146-L150), [`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L385-L417)).
- The descriptor index is intentionally per invocation: `gl_GlobalInvocationID.x` selects the same element across all three descriptor arrays, and the dispatch has one workgroup whose local size equals the array size ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L133-L160), [`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L523-L525)).
- The parameter matrix stresses both a small and a larger descriptor array while keeping the shader expression and verification formula fixed ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L598-L611), [`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L541-L582)).
- The registered test names are direct category-root children, not nested subgroup names, because `createDescriptorIndexingMiscTests` receives `mainGroup` and adds `CommonNonUniformDescriptorIndexTestCase` instances to it directly ([`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L587-L612)).

## Notes / Uncertainties

- The hierarchy tree is intentionally narrower than the full `descriptor_indexing` category because this page documents only the direct children registered by [`vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/descriptor_indexing/vktDescriptorIndexingMiscTests.cpp#L587-L612). If a future validator requires every category-root direct child on every page, the audit should treat this as a validator compatibility issue rather than a source-claim issue.
